bullets.text: Police arrested three people including a friend in connection with the murder of welder Gokul in Thirumullaivoyal, and the office should monitor public safety.
The meteorological department warned of heavy rain in Thiruvallur district on November 3, and the office should coordinate disaster preparedness measures.
Ponneri municipality refused to accept garbage from the local panchayat leaving it without dumping space, and the office should intervene to resolve the waste crisis.
Gummidipoondi traders detained a highway department vehicle over footpath vendor actions, and the office should engage with local traders and officials to restore order.
KONE Centennial Foundation visited Sevalaya in Tiruvallur supporting underprivileged children, and the office should acknowledge and encourage such educational initiatives.
Tamil Nadu allocated Rs 50 crore for startups to court gaming and AI companies, and the office should track investments to position the state as a technology creator.
The state plans restricted student Wi-Fi to block harmful online games, and the office should review the implementation of these digital safety measures.
L&T performed groundbreaking for its Vyoma.AI data centre project in Chennai, and the office should support infrastructure growth in the sector.
AMMK general secretary TTV Dhinakaran criticized the government over generator issues at the Thirumazhisai electric crematorium, and the office should verify facility operations.
